members: Dan T, Mike B, Pat D
happened: They put an AI agent on an inbound email, using Email and the CRM. The instruction says it is from a specified agent, collect who it is from and which policy it is for, notify the salesperson, then send API requests to pull the requested information and name a specialist.
issue: The next person is still "the named specialist" with no name. They are not told which materials to send (policy and illustration), which policy or person it is for, or whether to send today.
why: They caught the trap: this is from sales, not a client. That part is solid. A real next owner still has to guess who they are, what to pull, and who it is for beyond "a policy." Until the handoff names a person and the packet, they would have to ask.

board.members: Dan T, Mike B, Pat D
board.container: AI Agent — decides when the next step is not the same every time
board.instruction: I get the requests from a specified agent requesting this information. I collect who it is from and which policy it is for. Notify that sales person it has been received.  Send our API requests to the needed areas to retrieve the requested information
